purpose: Resolve a Facebook location.id to a place, once and forever, with no name matching, no accent handling and no AI call.
lifecycle: LEARNED AT RUNTIME. This file is NOT generated from the workbook and build_gazetteer.py never touches it. The write path is the Firestore collection `venues`; this file is the export the site and the n8n workflow read.
why_not_in_gazetteer_json: gazetteer.json is regenerated from Rome_Neighbourhood_Gazetteer_EN.xlsx. Merging the two would erase every learned venue on the first rebuild.
key: location.id from the Apify Facebook Events actor. Present in 106 of 107 measured records with a location, and stable across events at the same place.
position_in_resolution: After human_verified and the tier-A guards; before the tier-B guards and the alias lookup. A hit skips tier B and the model entirely. A MISS IS NOT A REJECT — it continues to the next step.
changes_in_1_1: venue_nature added: a signal for the editorial filter, not a shortcut past it.
editorial_override added: the only two cases where the venue decides on its own.
promotion_count added: how a blacklist is earned rather than assumed.

record_schema.name: string — venue name as last seen, for human review only, never a key
record_schema.publication_zone_id: string — joins publication_zones.publication_zone_id. Required when status = resolved
record_schema.human_verified: boolean — true means a person decided. Wins over any recomputation
record_schema.venue_nature: community | cultural | commercial | unknown — see venue_nature below
record_schema.editorial_override: none | whitelist | blacklist — see editorial_override below
record_schema.promotion_count: integer — how many items from this venue were classified `promotion`
record_schema.event_count: integer — how many events have carried this location.id

venue_nature.purpose: A prior passed to the editorial classifier alongside the item text. It moves the judgement; it does not make it.
venue_nature.why_not_a_shortcut: A neighbourhood pub hosts both its ordinary Thursday karaoke and a one-off gig by a named band. A permanent verdict on the venue would discard the gig — which is exactly the kind of item that is on no other site. Judge the item, with the venue as context.

values.community: Parish, committee, association, library, school, municipio premises, social centre.
values.cultural: Theatre, cinema, museum, bookshop, auditorium. Programming is the point of the place.
values.commercial: Bar, pub, restaurant, club, shop, gym. Events are a side of the trade.
values.unknown: Not yet judged. The default, and not an error.

editorial_override.purpose: The two extremes where the venue alone is enough, so the model is not spent on a decided question.

values.whitelist: Everything from this venue is local interest. Set by a person, for community venues only. A parish hall does not need its bingo night re-judged every month.
values.blacklist: Everything from this venue is skipped as promotion. EARNED, not assumed: set only after promotion_count reaches 3 with no local_interest item in between, and only by a person.

editorial_override.rule: An override is a human act and is logged like one. A blacklisted venue that later posts something real is a bug you will only find in the discarded sample — which is why ten discards are reviewed every week.

rules: A venue with status = unresolved is not an error and not, on its own, a reject: resolution continues to the alias lookup and the model. reject_reason = venue_unresolved is TERMINAL and fires only when the registry, the alias lookup and the model have all failed. One review then resolves every future event at that address.
human_verified = true is sticky. A later alias or AI result that disagrees sets status = disputed and is logged; it never overwrites the human value.

publication_zone_id must point at a zone with is_page = true. If the venue genuinely sits in Agro Romano, set status = resolved with the neighbourhood_id and leave publication_zone_id empty, then handle it as zone_not_published.
Never key on venue name. Two parish halls share a name; two spellings of one theatre do not share an id.
venue_nature and the geographic resolution are independent. A venue can be resolved geographically and unknown editorially, and the reverse.

changes_in_1_2: Registry miss is explicitly NOT a reject: it continues to the alias lookup and the model. venue_unresolved is terminal. v1.3 WORKFLOW_FIXES said otherwise and, with location.id present in 106 of 107 records, that reading would have queued the whole corpus on day one.
Position updated: after human_verified and the tier-A guards, BEFORE the tier-B suspicion guards. A hit skips tier B entirely.
